scope: Synthetic crowded initial layout, not natural discovery/growth or the final distributable EXE. Five byte-identical main archives cloned from a previously verified normal x1 awakened profile, with no consent/seed/marker copied. Production factories, RenderWorld/UpdateLayeredWindow and normal x1 Tick/Move/combat run for 12 wall-clock seconds. Only initial hero/enemy geometry and normal Boss combat authorization are set; HP/realm/damage/cooldowns/clocks are not edited. No scan, real maintenance, native input, foreground activation, other-app move/hide or timer pause. Raw other-app background pixels remain local QA evidence only. Short resource samples do not replace the paused long test.
